findings.message: Whether managers will decide in the app instead of replying by email is the assumption most likely to sink a request-and-approval tool, but it appears only under Risks, with no assumption id, owner or confirm-by date, so nobody is asked to answer it before the gate.
findings.suggested: | A-09 | Managers record their decision in the app instead of replying by email, so the app becomes the only record of a trip | The panel, asked by Eugene Tarasov in the walkthrough | 2026-12-04 |
findings.quote: If managers keep approving by email, there are two records again and the spreadsheet comes back.
